title: Collaboration or Corporate Capture? Quantifying NLP's Reliance on Industry Artifacts and Contributions
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. It is a meta-analysis of the NLP research field's reliance on industry contributions.
findings: The paper does not analyze or discuss religion, faith, or related topics. Its focus is on quantifying the reliance of NLP research on industry-produced artifacts and contributions by surveying papers from EMNLP 2022.
